description: Starts an audio generation on the signed-in aicut account, puts the aicut card in front of the user and returns the new job's id immediately. It does NOT wait for the audio. One tool for all three kinds, chosen by the `model` you pass: spoken voice-over, music and sound effects. WHEN: the user asks for speech, a voice-over, music, a soundtrack or a sound effect. Call `list_models` with `type: "audio"` first: the models take DIFFERENT arguments (speech: `text` and `voice`; music: `prompt` and `length_ms`; sound effect: `text` and `duration`), and a field the chosen model does not publish is rejected, not ignored. A speech `voice` id comes from `list_voices`, never from `list_models`. `get_recipe` `starter-audio` has the first-clip steps. HOW IT SOUNDS is steerable at no extra price (`stability`, `similarity_boost`, `style`, `speed` on speech; `force_instrumental` on music; `loop` on a sound effect), but only the knobs a model publishes in `parameters` are accepted. All are optional and change the result, never the price, so they need no re-quote. THE CARD: this call already opened the aicut card: do not call `show_generation` for this job. WAIT: `wait_for_generation` (this id, `media`), again at once while `terminal: false`, then one short line; no `get_*` polling, timers, background shells or narrating the wait. No card? Give the user the `url`. TIMING: audio usually finishes in under a minute (often 10 seconds for a short effect) and can take up to about 4 minutes for a long script. Do not spawn timers or background shells. COST: this spends the user's tokens, and audio is priced on a RATE (per character of speech, minute of music, second of sound effect), not a table: `list_models` gives `pricing_rates`. Never multiply it yourself: pass `estimate_only: true` with the exact settings you will send. Do that whenever the user has not agreed to the cost, and always before a long script or a long track. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).

duration.description: Sound-effect length in seconds within the model's `min`/`max`; billed per second. An omitted length is quoted at a fallback price. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

estimate_only.description: Price only; creates nothing. The only accurate way to price audio (see COST).

force_instrumental.description: Music: no vocals. Result only, not price.

length_ms.description: Music length in whole milliseconds within the model's `min`/`max`; billed per started minute. An omitted length is quoted at a fallback price, so `estimate_only` with the exact value is the only accurate quote. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

loop.description: Sound effects: loop seamlessly. Result only, not price.

model.description: Model id exactly as `list_models` returns it (`elevenlabs-tts-v2` speech, `elevenlabs-music` music, `elevenlabs-sfx` sound effect); it decides which other arguments apply. Use the one the user asked for.

prompt.description: Music: a description of the track (mood, instruments, tempo). Speech and sound-effect models take `text` and reject this.

prompt_influence.description: Sound effects: how literally to follow the text (the model's `min`/`max`). Result only, not price.

similarity_boost.description: Speech, `elevenlabs-tts-v2` and `-v4` only: how closely the delivery sticks to the voice. Result only.

speed.description: Speech, `elevenlabs-tts-v2` only: speaking rate, 1 is normal. Result only.

stability.description: Speech: how steady the delivery is (lower more expressive, higher flatter). Result only, not price.

style.description: Speech, `elevenlabs-tts-v2` only: how far the speaker's own style is exaggerated. Result only.

text.description: Speech: the exact words to speak (priced PER CHARACTER: never padded or shortened to change the price). Sound effect: a description of the sound. Only if the user asked; never to save tokens, never carried over.

voice.description: Required by speech models. Get it from `list_voices` with `provider: 'elevenlabs', usable_for: 'audio', limit: 100` (21 stock voices; without `limit` you see 20 and cannot tell). The user picks it from `preview_url` links BEFORE this call. Never invent one: it fails AFTER the job exists and is charged. Cloned and custom voices work on `generate_fake_text_video` and `generate_image_story`, not here.
